injuries.summary:
## Injury briefing

### Season-ending losses
- **Giants WR Braxton Berrios** — will undergo **season-ending foot surgery**, per his Instagram announcement.
  - **Why it matters:** New York loses a depth receiver and return-game option for the rest of the year.
  - **Watch next:** How the Giants redistribute receiver snaps and special-teams duties.

- **Ravens TE Durham Smythe** — suffered a **season-ending torn Achilles** after limping off in Sunday’s win over the Titans and being quickly ruled out.
  - **Why it matters:** Baltimore takes a hit at tight end depth, which could affect pass-game usage and package versatility.
  - **Watch next:** Who fills Smythe’s role and whether the Ravens adjust personnel near the line of scrimmage.

### Returning players
- **No returning-from-injury players were specified** in today’s data.
